name: source_table
description: SOURCE child table FQN the fan-out was measured against.

name: edge_cols
description: Comma-joined driving edge FK columns (child side).

name: model_sha
description: Model/prompt sha the measurement is scoped to (cache key component).

name: payload
description: JSON-encoded measurement payload: the FanoutPlan histogram + PK cells, and (ADR 0038 fix J) the declared PK's own source measurement under "pk" (rows, key_tuples, max_rows_per_key). No column change — a row written before fix J simply lacks the key.
